items.reason: The gap describes two deliveries of the same id both passing the set check while jobs run concurrently, so the handler runs twice before either records the id.
Gap 1 notes the key comes from X-Event-Id but attaches 'unsigned' to the body id field and only says the header may disagree or be absent, never that the header is outside the signature or forgeable.
The gap says the provider sends charge.refunded while only refund.created is registered, so refunds never invoke the refund handler.
No gap depends on several processes or instances; the concurrency raised is among jobs within one process.
